verdict.tagline: Large scale sandbox battles run smoothly on modest hardware.
for_you_if: you want classic tactical combat against bots
you enjoy large scale sandbox gameplay
not_for_you_if: you need an option to invert controls
you overload the game with unstable workshop mods

distortion_flags.sentence: Approval rises steadily as playtime increases from the refund window to veteran cohorts.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Veterans explore custom campaigns and weapons while reporting instability from excessive workshop mods.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features custom campaigns, map changes, and various weapons such as the ingress and supernova.

citations.review_text: Great Sandbox / battle simulator where everything can be heavily modified through mods which are done really well and heavily supported by the community - everything from entire maps down to equipment and vehicles used can be altered / changed as well as more complex features thanks to mutators like custom flags , weather effects , multi skin randomisation for teams etc . Very replayable and still is updated with cool stuff like the new custom campaigns , map changes and weapons like the ingress and supernova.
yes i like the new campain mode i think you should allowed both modes of the campain and make the new mode longer. other then that i would 100% get this game

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as currently being in early access.

citations.review_text: Beautiful game. I am aware it is in early access, but I'd like it a lot more if it had a little more weapons and maybe different skins. I own a lot of mods and it makes the game entirely different that what it actually is. Its a good game without the mods but it gets a little too boring after a bit. There is different game modes, and my favorite parts of the game are the spectator mode and the skirmish battle mode. Its fun, you just might need a little bit of mutator mods

This is legitimately the first ever shooter game I've played. I've been playing since before the wrench and ATV were added, and before the game came to steam. The game has been in early access for a while now, and has had a couple updates. But as you may have heard, the real strength of the game comes from it's steam workshop. I've fought massive medieval battles, done long range tank and aircraft combat in the scorching desert, flew as gunship support to attack a fortified compound, stormed trenches as artillery and AA batteries fired at me, Fast paced CQB on a train with only a tiny squad to back me up, and even fired railguns on the moon. The mods alone allow players to customize their game to an incredible degree, and I'm definitely looking forward to how the game evolves in the future. Get the game, its $18.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that installing too many workshop mods can cause the game to crash or fail to load properly.
